titulo: Search books by title or author, with pagination
descricao: Readers need to find books. We want GET /books?q=<text>&page=<n>&perPage=<n>, which searches the title and the author, ignores case and accents, and returns paginated results.
criterios: new function searchBooks(q, { page, perPage }) in src/search.js
the search ignores upper/lower case and accents ('garcia' finds 'Gabriel García Márquez')
pagination: page starts at 1, perPage defaults to 10 with a maximum of 50; returns { total, page, perPage, results }
GET /books without q still returns the full list (compatibility)
tests for search, accents, pagination and errors
